questions.question: What does "wake up" mean?
questions.explanation: "Wake up" means vakne - when you stop sleeping in the morning.

questions.question: How do you say 7:30 in English?
questions.explanation: We say "half past seven" for 7:30 in English.

questions.question: What does "do homework" mean?
questions.explanation: "Do homework" means gjøre lekser - working on school assignments at home.
